senses.en: to keep something inside, or to stop someone going out

ex.en: We had to keep in the cat during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间我们只能把猫关在家里。

ex.en: Keep your hands in your pockets to stay warm.
ex.zh: 把手放在口袋里保暖。

tip: keep in 表示“关在屋内/放在里面”。
scene: A cat looking out of a window while kept inside a house.

senses.en: to continue doing something

ex.en: Keep on trying and you will succeed.
ex.zh: 继续努力，你会成功的。

ex.en: He kept on talking even when I was busy.
ex.zh: 我很忙的时候他还在继续说。

tip: keep on + 动名词 表示“持续做”。
scene: A child practising riding a bike, falling and getting up again.

senses.en: to move at the same speed, or to continue

ex.en: Run faster or you can't keep up with us!
ex.zh: 跑快点，不然你跟不上我们！

ex.en: She works hard to keep up with her classmates.
ex.zh: 她努力学习以跟上同学。

tip: keep up with 是“跟上（进度/步伐）”。
scene: Two runners on a track, one struggling to keep up with the other.

senses.en: short for goalkeeper, or a person who looks after things

ex.en: The keeper caught the ball easily.
ex.zh: 守门员轻松接住了球。

ex.en: The zoo keeper feeds the animals every day.
ex.zh: 动物园管理员每天喂动物。

tip: keeper 常指守门员（goalkeeper 的简称），也指管理员。
scene: A goalkeeper catching a ball in front of the goal.

senses.en: to hit someone to the ground, or to destroy a building

ex.en: The strong wind knocked down the old fence.
ex.zh: 大风把旧篱笆刮倒了。

ex.en: They plan to knock down the old building.
ex.zh: 他们计划拆除旧楼。

tip: knock down 表示“撞倒/拆除”。
scene: A digger knocking down an old brick wall.

senses.en: the flat green part of a plant

ex.en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天叶子变黄。

ex.en: A leaf fell from the tree and landed on the path.
ex.zh: 一片叶子从树上落下，落在小路上。

tip: leaf 的复数是 leaves（不规则变化）。
scene: A green leaf with veins falling from a tree in autumn.

senses.en: the bright flash of light in a storm

ex.en: Lightning lit up the sky during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中闪电照亮了天空。

ex.en: We saw lightning in the distance.
ex.zh: 我们看到了远处的闪电。

tip: lightning 是闪电；thunder 是雷声。
scene: A bright lightning bolt striking across a dark stormy sky.

senses.en: probable; expected to happen

ex.en: It is likely to rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午很可能下雨。

ex.en: She is likely to win the race.
ex.zh: 她很可能会赢得比赛。

tip: be likely to do 表示“很可能…”；反义 unlikely。
scene: Dark clouds over a park, people holding umbrellas.

senses.en: a sport where you jump as far as possible

ex.en: He broke the school record in the long jump.
ex.zh: 他打破了学校跳远纪录。

ex.en: The long jump competition starts at ten.
ex.zh: 跳远比赛十点开始。

tip: long jump 是跳远；high jump 是跳高。
scene: An athlete jumping far into a sand pit at a sports field.

senses.en: to feel excited about something in the future

ex.en: I look forward to seeing you next week.
ex.zh: 我期待下周见到你。

ex.en: The children look forward to the school trip.
ex.zh: 孩子们期待学校旅行。

tip: look forward to + 名词/动名词，注意 to 后接动名词。
scene: A child looking happily at a calendar counting down to a trip.

senses.en: to have the appearance of, or seem

ex.en: He looks like his father.
ex.zh: 他长得像他爸爸。

ex.en: It looks like it's going to snow.
ex.zh: 看起来要下雪了。

tip: look like 表示“长得像/看起来像”。
scene: A boy and his father standing side by side, looking alike.

senses.en: to find information, or to raise your eyes

ex.en: Look up the word in the dictionary.
ex.zh: 在词典里查这个词。

ex.en: Things are looking up for our team.
ex.zh: 我们队的情况正在好转。

tip: look up 表示“查阅（资料）”；look up to 是“尊敬”。
scene: A student looking up a word in a dictionary at a desk.

senses.en: to check that something is true or done

ex.en: Make sure you lock the door before leaving.
ex.zh: 离开前确保锁好门。

ex.en: She made sure all the lights were off.
ex.zh: 她确认所有灯都关了。

tip: make sure (that) + 从句，表示“确保”。
scene: A hand locking a door while holding keys.

senses.en: mathematics (American English)

ex.en: Math is my favourite subject at school.
ex.zh: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

ex.en: She is good at math and science.
ex.zh: 她擅长数学和科学。

tip: math 是美式说法；英式说 maths。
scene: A blackboard with maths equations written on it.

senses.en: between young and old, about 40 to 60

ex.en: The middle-aged man walked his dog every day.
ex.zh: 这位中年男子每天遛狗。

ex.en: The book is popular with middle-aged readers.
ex.zh: 这本书受中年读者欢迎。

tip: middle-aged 指中年（约40-60岁）。
scene: A middle-aged man walking his dog in a park.

senses.en: the sport of racing cars

ex.en: Motor-racing is a dangerous but exciting sport.
ex.zh: 赛车是一项危险但刺激的运动。

ex.en: He watches motor-racing on TV every weekend.
ex.zh: 他每周末在电视上看赛车。

tip: motor-racing 是赛车运动，车手叫 racing driver。
scene: Racing cars speeding around a track at high speed.

senses.en: informal word for mother

ex.en: Mum makes the best soup in the world.
ex.zh: 妈妈做的汤是世界上最好喝的。

ex.en: I told my mum about the school trip.
ex.zh: 我把学校旅行的事告诉了妈妈。

tip: mum 是英式说法；美式说 mom。
scene: A mother stirring soup in a kitchen while a child watches.

senses.en: very dark blue

ex.en: She wore a navy blue jacket to the interview.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件藏青色夹克去面试。

ex.en: The school uniform is navy blue.
ex.zh: 校服是藏青色的。

tip: navy blue 是深蓝/藏青色。
scene: A navy blue jacket hanging on a hanger.

senses.en: a place open at night for music and dancing

ex.en: The nightclub was very crowded on Friday.
ex.zh: 周五夜店非常拥挤。

ex.en: You must be over eighteen to enter the nightclub.
ex.zh: 年满十八岁才能进夜店。

tip: nightclub 是夜店；注意未成年人禁止进入。
scene: A neon-lit nightclub entrance with music signs at night.

senses.en: certainly; used to agree

ex.en: 'Can you help me?' 'Of course!'
ex.zh: “你能帮我吗？”“当然！”

ex.en: Of course, I'll come to your party.
ex.zh: 我当然会来参加你的聚会。

tip: of course 表示“当然”，是肯定回答。
scene: A person nodding and smiling while saying of course.

senses.en: on a ship, plane or vehicle

ex.en: All passengers are now on board the plane.
ex.zh: 所有乘客都已登机。

ex.en: Welcome on board the train to London.
ex.zh: 欢迎乘坐开往伦敦的火车。

tip: on board 表示“在交通工具上”，如 get on board 登机/上船。
scene: Passengers boarding a plane through the door.

senses.en: working, not on holiday

ex.en: He travels to Shanghai on business every month.
ex.zh: 他每月出差去上海。

ex.en: I'm here on business, not for a holiday.
ex.zh: 我来这里是出差，不是度假。

tip: on business 表示“出差”；on holiday 是“度假”。
scene: A person in a suit with a briefcase at an airport.

senses.en: burning

ex.en: The kitchen was on fire, so we called 119.
ex.zh: 厨房着火了，我们拨了119。

ex.en: The old barn caught on fire last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚旧谷仓着火了。

tip: catch fire 是“着火”；be on fire 是“正在燃烧”。
scene: Flames rising from a building with a fire engine arriving.

senses.en: walking, not using transport

ex.en: We went to the station on foot.
ex.zh: 我们步行去车站。

ex.en: The school is close, so I go there on foot.
ex.zh: 学校很近，所以我步行去。

tip: on foot 表示“步行”；go on foot 步行去。
scene: People walking along a pavement towards a station.

senses.en: on vacation; taking a break from work

ex.en: The Smiths are on holiday in Spain this week.
ex.zh: 史密斯一家这周在西班牙度假。

ex.en: She is on holiday and will be back on Monday.
ex.zh: 她在度假，周一回来。

tip: on holiday 是英式“度假”；美式说 on vacation。
scene: A family with sunglasses relaxing on a sunny beach.

senses.en: intentionally; not by accident

ex.en: He broke the cup on purpose.
ex.zh: 他故意打碎了杯子。

ex.en: She didn't hurt you on purpose.
ex.zh: 她不是故意伤害你的。

tip: on purpose 是“故意”；反义 by accident/by mistake。
scene: A boy deliberately knocking over a cup on a table.

senses.en: if someone asks for it

ex.en: A free map is available on request at the desk.
ex.zh: 前台可应要求提供免费地图。

ex.en: Vegetarian meals are served on request.
ex.zh: 应要求提供素食。

tip: on request 表示“经要求提供”，常用于服务说明。
scene: A hotel reception desk with a free map sign.

senses.en: available at a lower price

ex.en: These shoes are on sale this week.
ex.zh: 这些鞋本周打折。

ex.en: I bought the jacket because it was on sale.
ex.zh: 我买这件夹克是因为它在打折。

tip: on sale 是“打折”；for sale 是“待出售”。
scene: A shop window with big sale signs and discount tags.

senses.en: at the correct time

ex.en: The train arrived on time.
ex.zh: 火车准点到达。

ex.en: Please be on time for the meeting.
ex.zh: 请准时参加会议。

tip: on time 是“准时”；in time 是“及时”。
scene: A station clock showing the exact time as a train arrives.

senses.en: on holiday (American English)

ex.en: They are on vacation in Hawaii.
ex.zh: 他们在夏威夷度假。

ex.en: The office is closed because the boss is on vacation.
ex.zh: 老板去度假了，办公室关门。

tip: on vacation 是美式说法；英式说 on holiday。
scene: A couple with beach bags walking on a tropical beach.

senses.en: the hours when a shop or office is open

ex.en: The museum's opening hours are ten to five.
ex.zh: 博物馆的营业时间是十点到五点。

ex.en: Check the opening hours before you visit.
ex.zh: 参观前请查看营业时间。

tip: opening hours 是营业/开放时间。
scene: A sign on a shop door showing the opening hours.

senses.en: no longer fresh, or no longer modern

ex.en: The milk is out of date; don't drink it.
ex.zh: 牛奶过期了，别喝。

ex.en: This old phone is out of date now.
ex.zh: 这部旧手机现在过时了。

tip: out of date 是“过期/过时”；up to date 是“最新”。
scene: An open fridge with an old milk carton and an expiry date.

senses.en: not working (about machines)

ex.en: The lift is out of order, so use the stairs.
ex.zh: 电梯故障，请走楼梯。

ex.en: The ticket machine is out of order today.
ex.zh: 售票机今天出故障了。

tip: out of order 表示机器“故障/不能使用”。
scene: A lift with an out of order sign and people using the stairs.

senses.en: unemployed; without a job

ex.en: He has been out of work since March.
ex.zh: 他从三月起就失业了。

ex.en: Many people are out of work in the town.
ex.zh: 镇上有许多人失业。

tip: out of work 表示“失业”；unemployed 是更正式的说法。
scene: A person reading job adverts at a job centre.

senses.en: working fewer hours than full time

ex.en: She has a part-time job in a café.
ex.zh: 她在咖啡馆做兼职。

ex.en: He works part time while studying.
ex.zh: 他边学习边兼职。

tip: part time 是“兼职”；反义 full time 全职。
scene: A student serving coffee part time at a café counter.

senses.en: especially; more than usual

ex.en: I particularly enjoyed the music at the concert.
ex.zh: 我特别喜欢音乐会上的音乐。

ex.en: It was particularly cold this winter.
ex.zh: 今年冬天特别冷。

tip: particularly 表示“尤其、特别地”。
scene: A person smiling at a concert, enjoying the music especially.

senses.en: to give something to another person

ex.en: Please pass on my message to your sister.
ex.zh: 请把我的口信转告你妹妹。

ex.en: She passed on the information to the team.
ex.zh: 她把信息传递给了团队。

tip: pass on 表示“转交/转告”。
scene: One friend handing a note to another to pass on.

senses.en: small money given to children by parents

ex.en: She saves her pocket money to buy books.
ex.zh: 她存零花钱买书。

ex.en: My pocket money is ten pounds a week.
ex.zh: 我的零花钱是每周十英镑。

tip: pocket money 是孩子每周的零花钱；美式说 allowance。
scene: A parent giving coins to a happy child.

senses.en: a female police officer

ex.en: The policewoman directed the traffic at the junction.
ex.zh: 女警察在路口指挥交通。

ex.en: She became a policewoman after university.
ex.zh: 她大学毕业后当了女警察。

tip: policewoman 复数 policewomen。
scene: A female police officer directing traffic at a road junction.

senses.en: a person who introduces a TV or radio show

ex.en: The presenter welcomed the guests on the show.
ex.zh: 主持人在节目里欢迎嘉宾。

ex.en: She works as a news presenter.
ex.zh: 她是一名新闻主持人。

tip: presenter 是节目主持人；host 也指主持人。
scene: A TV presenter speaking into a microphone in a studio.

senses.en: a school for young children

ex.en: My son goes to the local primary school.
ex.zh: 我儿子在本地小学上学。

ex.en: Primary school starts at nine in the morning.
ex.zh: 小学早上九点上课。

tip: primary school 是英式“小学”；美式说 elementary school。
scene: A primary school building with young children at the gate.

senses.en: things given for winning

ex.en: The winners received their prizes at the ceremony.
ex.zh: 获奖者在典礼上领了奖。

ex.en: There are three prizes for the best projects.
ex.zh: 最佳项目有三个奖项。

tip: prizes 是 prize 的复数，奖品/奖金。
scene: A table with shiny trophies and certificates for winners.

senses.en: a person who writes computer programs

ex.en: She works as a programmer for a tech company.
ex.zh: 她在一家科技公司当程序员。

ex.en: The programmer fixed the problem in the app.
ex.zh: 程序员修复了应用里的问题。

tip: programmer 是程序员；美式拼写也作 programmer。
scene: A programmer typing code on a computer with two screens.

senses.en: buses and trains that everyone can use

ex.en: Public transport is cheap and convenient here.
ex.zh: 这里公共交通便宜又方便。

ex.en: Many people use public transport to go to work.
ex.zh: 许多人乘公共交通上班。

tip: public transport 是公共交通（公交、地铁、火车）。
scene: A bus and a train moving through a city street.

senses.en: a company or person that publishes books

ex.en: The publisher released the new novel in June.
ex.zh: 出版社六月发行了这部新小说。

ex.en: She sent her story to several publishers.
ex.zh: 她把故事寄给了几家出版社。

tip: publisher 是出版社/出版商。
scene: A publisher's office with stacks of new books on a table.

senses.en: a sweater you pull over your head

ex.en: He wore a warm pullover in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天他穿一件保暖套头毛衣。

ex.en: This grey pullover is my favourite.
ex.zh: 这件灰色套头毛衣是我的最爱。

tip: pullover 是套头毛衣；美式说 sweater。
scene: A grey pullover folded on a bed in a bedroom.

senses.en: to put something in its proper place

ex.en: Put away your toys before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前把玩具收好。

ex.en: She put away the clean clothes in the drawers.
ex.zh: 她把干净衣服收进抽屉。

tip: put away 是“收起来放好”。
scene: A child putting toys into a storage box.

senses.en: to place something down, or to write down

ex.en: Put down your bag and sit down.
ex.zh: 放下包，坐下来。

ex.en: Put down your name on the list.
ex.zh: 在名单上写下你的名字。

tip: put down 表示“放下”或“记下”。
scene: A person putting a heavy bag down on the floor.

senses.en: to delay something to a later time

ex.en: They put off the meeting until Friday.
ex.zh: 他们把会议推迟到周五。

ex.en: Don't put off your homework till the last minute.
ex.zh: 别把作业拖到最后一刻。

tip: put off 表示“推迟”；put off doing 是“拖延做某事”。
scene: A calendar with a meeting crossed out and moved to Friday.

senses.en: to stop a fire or light burning

ex.en: The firemen put out the fire quickly.
ex.zh: 消防员很快扑灭了大火。

ex.en: Please put out the candle before you sleep.
ex.zh: 睡前请吹灭蜡烛。

tip: put out 表示“扑灭（火）、熄灭（灯）”。
scene: A firefighter spraying water to put out a small fire.

senses.en: to connect someone on the phone

ex.en: Please put me through to the manager.
ex.zh: 请帮我接通经理。

ex.en: She was put through to the wrong department.
ex.zh: 她被接到了错误的部门。

tip: put through 是电话用语“接通”。
scene: A receptionist on the phone connecting a caller.

senses.en: to build, hang or raise something

ex.en: They put up a tent in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们在花园里搭了一顶帐篷。

ex.en: Please put up your hand if you know the answer.
ex.zh: 知道答案请举手。

tip: put up 有“搭起、张贴、举起”等义。
scene: Two people putting up a tent in a garden.

senses.en: to stop doing something or leave a job

ex.en: He quit his job to travel around the world.
ex.zh: 他辞职去环游世界。

ex.en: She quit smoking last year.
ex.zh: 她去年戒烟了。

tip: quit 是“放弃/辞职/停止”；过去式 quit。
scene: A person handing in a letter at an office desk.

senses.en: the railway system (American English)

ex.en: The railroad crosses the whole country.
ex.zh: 这条铁路贯穿全国。

ex.en: They took photos of the old railroad station.
ex.zh: 他们拍了旧火车站的照片。

tip: railroad 是美式说法；英式说 railway。
scene: A train running along railroad tracks across green fields.

senses.en: made smaller or cheaper

ex.en: The reduced prices attracted many customers.
ex.zh: 降价吸引了许多顾客。

ex.en: She bought the jacket at a reduced price.
ex.zh: 她以折扣价买了这件夹克。

tip: reduced 表示“减价/降低的”；at a reduced price 打折价。
scene: A shop rack with red reduced price tags on clothes.

senses.en: light food and drinks served at an event

ex.en: Refreshments will be served after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会议后将供应茶点。

ex.en: We stopped for refreshments at the café.
ex.zh: 我们在咖啡馆停下来吃点东西。

tip: refreshments 常用复数，指会议/活动上的小食饮品。
scene: A table with tea, coffee and small cakes at a meeting.

senses.en: good wishes sent to someone

ex.en: Please give my regards to your parents.
ex.zh: 请代我向你父母问好。

ex.en: With best regards, Anna.
ex.zh: 此致最美好的祝愿，安娜。

col: best regards｜致以最美好的祝愿
tip: best regards 是信件结尾敬语；give my regards to 是“代我问候”。
scene: A person signing a letter with best regards at a desk.

senses.en: calm and not worried

ex.en: She felt relaxed after the long holiday.
ex.zh: 长假后她感到放松。

ex.en: The relaxed atmosphere made everyone comfortable.
ex.zh: 轻松的氛围让每个人都很自在。

tip: relaxed 形容人的感受；relaxing 形容事物令人放松。
scene: A person relaxing in a bath with candles and calm music.

senses.en: a small device used to control a machine from a distance

ex.en: Pass me the remote control, please.
ex.zh: 请把遥控器递给我。

ex.en: The TV remote control needs new batteries.
ex.zh: 电视遥控器需要换电池。

tip: remote control 是遥控器，口语常简称 remote。
scene: A TV remote control lying on a sofa with a TV in the background.

senses.en: the time when you stop working because of age

ex.en: My grandfather enjoys gardening after retirement.
ex.zh: 爷爷退休后喜欢园艺。

ex.en: She is planning for her retirement.
ex.zh: 她正在规划退休生活。

tip: retirement 是“退休”；retired 是“退休的”。
scene: A retired man watering flowers in his garden.

senses.en: a person who rides a horse or bike

ex.en: The rider fell off the horse but was not hurt.
ex.zh: 骑手从马上摔下来但没有受伤。

ex.en: A bicycle rider passed us quickly.
ex.zh: 一个骑自行车的人很快超过我们。

tip: rider 是骑手（骑马/骑自行车）。
scene: A rider on a horse jumping over a fence at an equestrian event.

senses.en: on or towards the right side

ex.en: The shops are on the right-hand side of the street.
ex.zh: 商店在街道右侧。

ex.en: She is my right-hand helper in the office.
ex.zh: 她是我在办公室的得力助手。

tip: right-hand 是“右侧的”；right-hand side 右侧。
scene: A street with shops lined up on the right-hand side.

senses.en: to phone someone back

ex.en: I'll ring you back after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会议后我给你回电话。

ex.en: She rang back ten minutes later.
ex.zh: 十分钟后她回了电话。

tip: ring back 是英式“回电话”；美式说 call back。
scene: A person returning a phone call at an office desk.

senses.en: to phone someone, or to total a sale

ex.en: I'll ring up the restaurant to book a table.
ex.zh: 我会打电话给餐厅订位。

ex.en: The cashier rang up the items at the checkout.
ex.zh: 收银员在收银台结算商品。

tip: ring up 表示“打电话”（英式）。
scene: A person calling a restaurant to book a table.

senses.en: a person who shares a room or flat with you

ex.en: My roommate is from Italy.
ex.zh: 我的室友来自意大利。

ex.en: She gets on well with her roommate.
ex.zh: 她和室友相处得很好。

tip: roommate 是室友；英式分房间共享说 flatmate/housemate。
scene: Two roommates chatting in a shared bedroom.

senses.en: to use all of something and have none left

ex.en: We ran out of milk, so I went to the shop.
ex.zh: 牛奶喝完了，所以我去商店。

ex.en: Time is running out for the exam.
ex.zh: 考试时间快用完了。

tip: run out of + 名词 表示“用完某物”。
scene: An empty milk carton in a fridge.
